shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- APP SHELL MATCHES ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 'app shell|navigation|uikit|ThemeProvider' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- traps ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 'ThemeProvider|Button view|typography|Flex|theme|Switch' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && printf '\\n--- source ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button ThemeProvider Switch Card && printf '\\n--- UIKIT THEMING DOCS ---\\n' && (test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md || true) && printf '\\n--- NAV DOCS ---\\n' && (test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs/INDEX.md && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs/INDEX.md || test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md)"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button ThemeProvider Switch Card; printf '\\n--- UIKIT THEMING DOCS ---\\n'; if test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md; then sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md; fi; printf '\\n--- NAV DOCS ---\\n'; if test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs/INDEX.md; then sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs/INDEX.md; elif test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md; then sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md; fi"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '\\n--- NAV INDEX ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- NAV TYPE ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- THEME TYPES ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; printf '\\n--- UIKIT README THEME ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 'ThemeProvider|styles.css|theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && printf '\\n--- THEME DECLS ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && printf '\\n--- SWITCH DECL ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && printf '\\n--- BUTTON DECL ---\\n' && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'styles.css|navigation.css|import.*css|renderFooter|onItemClick|ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -100; printf '\\n--- Switch control props ---\\n'; rg -n -C 4 'interface ControlProps|type ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- icons exports relevant ---\\n'; rg -n 'House|Person|Clock|Briefcase|Grid|Bolt|ChartLine|Moon|Sun|CircleQuestion' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -60; printf '\\n--- nav menu types ---\\n'; rg -n -C 4 'interface MenuItem|type MenuItem|interface LogoProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '120,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -10; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm | rg '/types\\.d\\.ts"'$'"' | head; rg -n 'House|Persons|Briefcase|Clock|Grid|CircleQuestion' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build | head -30; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n -C 2 'type MenuItem|interface MenuItem|type LogoProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/{House*,Folder*,Clock*,Moon*,Sun*,Person*}.d.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg -n '\"exports\"|\"types\"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -20; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/index.d.ts; rg -n -C 3 'fonts.css|navigation/styles|@gravity-ui/navigation/styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md; sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Typography/Typography.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n 'TextProps|TextVariant|type Text' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Typography -g '*.d.ts'; rg -n 'MenuItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | tail -10; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/House.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg '/Text(/|\\.d\\.ts)' | head -15; rg -n 'Typography|TextVariant|type Text' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; rg -n 'renderFooter' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | tail -3; sed -n '370,420p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/types.d.ts; rg -n 'export type SVGIconData|interface SVGIconData' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon -g '*.d.ts'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/House.js | head -c 300"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/main.tsx package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"
/bin/bash -lc "find dist -type f -delete 2>/dev/null; find dist -depth -type d -empty -delete 2>/dev/null; git status --short; sed -n '1,22p' src/main.tsx"
